walkthroughs.body_html:
Fundamentals Of Data Structures — a core area of A-Level Computer Science.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Fundamentals Of Data Structures brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Fundamentals Of Data Structures.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Stack overflow”?
options: Fixed-size array queue where rear wraps to front, avoiding wasted space.
Double-ended queue allowing insertion and removal from both front and back.
Error when more items are pushed than the stack can hold (or recursion is too deep).
FIFO abstract data type with enqueue and dequeue; used for scheduling and BFS.

options: FIFO abstract data type with enqueue and dequeue; used for scheduling and BFS.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Priority queue”?
options: Double-ended queue allowing insertion and removal from both front and back.

Error when more items are pushed than the stack can hold (or recursion is too deep).
